title: Triathlon & Multisport Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=transition:log) OR (index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="transition:log","primary",sourcetype="trainingpeaks:workout","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from transition:log and trainingpeaks:workout to see whether two triathlon feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `transition:log` and `trainingpeaks:workout` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main triathlon data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
